title: Text Processing & Embeddings
summary: This module provides tools for processing and splitting text from various formats (plain text, HTML, JSON) into manageable chunks, as well as utilities for initializing and caching text embedding models from different providers.

nodes.label: Raw Text Input
nodes.title: Unstructured text data
nodes.description: Any form of plain text content that needs to be processed or analyzed.

nodes.label: HTML Content Input
nodes.title: HTML formatted web content
nodes.description: Web pages or other documents structured with HTML tags, requiring specialized parsing.

nodes.label: JSON Data Input
nodes.title: Structured JSON data
nodes.description: Data represented in JSON format, often nested, that needs to be broken down into smaller, manageable parts.

nodes.label: Split by Tokens
nodes.title: Splits text based on token count
nodes.description: Divides text into chunks using a model's tokenizer (e.g., tiktoken), ensuring chunks adhere to a specified token limit with optional overlap.

nodes.label: Split HTML by Headers
nodes.title: Splits HTML content by header tags
nodes.description: Parses HTML and creates structured documents by splitting content based on specified header tags (e.g., h1, h2), preserving hierarchy and metadata.

nodes.label: Semantic HTML Splitter
nodes.title: Splits HTML preserving semantic structure
nodes.description: Divides HTML content into semantically meaningful chunks, handling headers, links, and media, and further splitting large chunks with a recursive text splitter.

nodes.label: HTML Section Splitter
nodes.title: Splits HTML into sections by tags/fonts
nodes.description: Splits HTML documents into sections based on specified header tags and font sizes, using XSLT for transformation and BeautifulSoup for parsing.

nodes.label: Recursive JSON Splitter
nodes.title: Splits JSON data recursively
nodes.description: Breaks down nested JSON objects into smaller, structured chunks while maintaining their hierarchical relationships, based on configurable size limits.

nodes.label: SpaCy Sentence Splitter
nodes.title: Splits text into sentences using SpaCy
nodes.description: Utilizes the SpaCy library to segment raw text into individual sentences, providing fine-grained control over text chunking.

nodes.label: Embedding Model Factory
nodes.title: Initializes various embedding models
nodes.description: A factory function to create embedding models from different providers (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace) based on a model name and optional provider.

nodes.label: Fireworks Embeddings
nodes.title: Generates embeddings using Fireworks AI
nodes.description: An embedding model implementation that interfaces with the Fireworks AI API to generate vector representations of text.

nodes.label: Cache-Backed Embeddings
nodes.title: Caches embedding model results
nodes.description: Wraps an underlying embedding model to cache document and query embeddings, reducing redundant computations and improving performance.

nodes.label: Processed Text Chunks
nodes.title: Segmented text for further processing
nodes.description: Smaller, manageable segments of text or documents, ready for tasks like embedding, summarization, or retrieval.

nodes.label: Text Embeddings
nodes.title: Vector representations of text
nodes.description: Numerical vector representations of text, used for similarity search, clustering, and other NLP tasks.

nodes.label: External Embedding Providers
nodes.title: APIs for generating text embeddings
nodes.description: Third-party services or libraries that provide text embedding capabilities, such as OpenAI, Cohere, or HuggingFace.

groups.label: Text Splitting
groups.title: Tools for segmenting text
groups.description: Components designed to break down large text inputs from various formats into smaller, more manageable chunks for further processing.

groups.label: Embedding Management
groups.title: Tools for generating and caching embeddings
groups.description: Components for initializing diverse embedding models and implementing caching strategies to optimize embedding generation.
